name: Deltoid · anterior
flow: Clavicle to the front of the upper arm.

name: Deltoid · lateral
flow: Acromion to the outer upper arm.

name: Deltoid · posterior
flow: Scapular spine toward the back of the upper arm.

name: Biceps · long head
flow: Outer anterior upper arm; shortens as the elbow bends.

name: Biceps · short head
flow: Inner anterior upper arm toward the elbow.

name: Triceps · long head
flow: Scapula down the inner back of the upper arm.

name: Triceps · lateral head
flow: Outer posterior upper arm toward the elbow tendon.

name: Triceps · medial head
flow: Deep head visible near the inner elbow.

name: Trapezius · upper
flow: Neck toward the clavicle and acromion.

name: Trapezius · middle
flow: Upper spine horizontally toward the scapula.

name: Trapezius · lower
flow: Mid spine diagonally upward toward the scapula.

name: Hamstrings · biceps long head
flow: Outer posterior thigh toward the fibular head.

name: Hamstrings · biceps short head
flow: Distal outer thigh; lies beneath the long head.

name: Hamstrings · semitendinosus
flow: Long medial posterior thigh toward the inner knee.

name: Hamstrings · semimembranosus
flow: Broad medial posterior thigh.

name: Calf · medial head
flow: Inner calf belly converging toward the Achilles.

name: Calf · lateral head
flow: Outer calf belly converging toward the Achilles.

name: Adductor longus
flow: Superficial inner thigh from pubis toward femur.

name: Adductor magnus
flow: Broad inner and posterior thigh.

name: Gracilis
flow: Narrow strap along the inner thigh to the knee.

name: Fibularis longus
flow: Outer lower leg, continuing behind the lateral ankle.

name: Fibularis brevis
flow: Lower outer leg toward the base of the fifth metatarsal.

name: Gluteus maximus
flow: Broad diagonal fan across the buttock.

name: Gluteus medius
flow: Lateral hip fan toward the greater trochanter.

name: Longissimus thoracis
flow: Long column beside the thoracic and lumbar spine.

name: Iliocostalis lumborum
flow: Lateral lumbar column toward the lower ribs.

name: Wrist extensor · longus
flow: Radial forearm toward the back of the wrist.

name: Wrist extensor · brevis
flow: Shorter radial extensor beside the longus.
